# glad 2.0.8: the OpenGL function loader for desktop GL (OpenGL 3.3 core
# profile with anisotropic filtering and KHR_debug). include/ and src/ are
# generated by generate.py, which pins the glad version and its bundled
# specification; run it again to change them. Static and private to the GL
# backend plugin, which loads it from its context.
add_library(glad STATIC
	include/glad/gl.h
	include/KHR/khrplatform.h
	src/gl.c
)
target_include_directories(glad PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
# linked into the plugin
set_target_properties(glad PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
